summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] union member; rich/control.py adds the format entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and Control.title(); rich/_windows_renderer.py dispatches SET_WINDOW_TITLE to term.set_title(title); rich/console.py adds set_window_title() beside show_cursor, returning True only when the console is a terminal. CHANGELOG.md has an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added in tests/test_console.py, tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Tests and Black were not run, per instructions; verification was by reading only. Nothing was committed.
